recap:
BHA Masters the Chaos, Edges Out Liverpool in Thrilling Two-Goal Battle

BHA secured a 2-1 victory over LIV by controlling the tempo against the opposition, despite Liverpool having slightly better possession (50.8% vs 49.2%). BHA demonstrated superior control against chaos, maintaining a tight pressing structure with a PPDA of 7.8, which was significantly tougher than Liverpool’s 12.8. While BHA’s counter-press was slightly below plan at 21%, it was effective in creating crucial opportunities.

The match was defined by two decisive moments. The first came at minute 19 when #9 Harvey Radley scored for BHA following a high regain, proving the team's ability to convert transitional moments into goals. The match swung late when LIV scored at minute 41 through a swift counter-attack, assisted by #11 Rafael Marchetti.

The defining moment for BHA was the second goal at minute 63. This came from a set piece, where a corner routine led to a near-post flick, and #5 Isaac Kane-Moss converted the chance. This goal, assisted by #7 Tomas Calloway, sealed the win and showcased BHA's effectiveness from dead-ball situations.
